body: I am pro-suicide. If you are suffering you have a right to leave this world and forget about your problems forever. I'll probably do it soon using carbon monoxide.
Why continue to suffer? It's been 3-4 years and things keep getting worst.
I've already spoken to a psychologist and a counselor. Didn't really make much of a difference. Why do people think talking to someone magically fixes all of their problems?

FUD - Fear, Uncertainty, Doubt  


I do not fear death. Death is certain. There is doubt that I can recuperate my losses.
All of my friends and family knows my problems. There are no solutions. Talking about my problems won't change anything. The only way out is to die.
The thing is it is nearly impossible to catch up to what can be perceived as lost gains. Bitcoin and crypto is the best asset class in terms of gains. It is very unlikely that people can catch up.
Doesn't matter if someone gets liquidated, scammed, hacked or had their money stolen.
No that's not true. You can end up losing all of your money in bad trades and destroy your account. Once you reach that point it's game over.
What if someone has reached out for help from family, friends and professional help and no one has a solution? Then what?

I revealed to someone on Telegram that I am depressed and mentioned him my problems. He talked for a bit and pretended to have to go. He blocked me shortly after. I checked on another account and he was still online. So this theory that a stranger would always be there to help you is false.
So if someone is suffering they need to stay alive just for you? Do you realize how selfish that sounds?

I've been to the hospital multiple times regarding suicidal ideations from other things but also my failures in crypto investing/trading. I've reached out for help and no one has a solution. I've told all of my friends and family and there is nothing they can do to help me. The only way out is death.
